What is cloud computing?

options.text: The delivery of computing services over the internet
A method for building physical datacenters faster
A replacement for all networking hardware

questions.explanation: Cloud computing delivers computing services such as VMs, storage, databases, and networking over the internet.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a cloud computing service?
questions.explanation: Virtual machines are a core cloud service.

questions.question: Why can cloud computing scale faster than traditional datacenters?

options.text: It is not constrained by physical infrastructure
It uses custom hardware built on demand
It eliminates the need for networking

questions.explanation: Cloud services are delivered over the internet, so they are not limited by physical datacenter build times.
